name: Harborline Manufacturing Co.
inspection_reqs: Annual surveillance of confirmed and assumed ACM. Three-year reinspection of TSI and surfacing. Pre-renovation survey required before any cutting, grinding, or demolition.
reporting_reqs: Building inventory PDF + XLSX after each inspection. Notify EHS within 24 hours of newly damaged ACM.
notes: Photography limited on the shop floor (active production). Coordinate with shift supervisor. Night access for boiler house preferred.

name: Cass Corridor Housing Authority
inspection_reqs: HUD / AHERA-style periodic surveillance every 6 months for occupied residential buildings. Reinspection every 3 years.
reporting_reqs: Resident notice 48 hours before any interior inspection. Unit-level inventory after each survey.
notes: Resident-occupied. Do not photograph residents or unit interiors without written approval.
